name: Bastions
hero_subtitle: Angel, Holy Spirit and ocean horizons from the corners of the citadel.

overview.title: Defensive corners with ocean views
overview.p1: The four corner bastions of the Portuguese City (Angel, Holy Spirit, Saint Sebastian and the fourth) structured the defence of the fortress and today offer the best viewpoints over the Atlantic.
overview.p2: Each bastion has its character. The Angel bastion is among the most photographed. Cannons still point seaward along the walls.
overview.p3: Integrate the bastions into a full walk of the ramparts. Access is free and open.

q1.question: How much time for Bastions?
q1.answer: 30 to 60 minutes is usually enough for a good visit.

q2.question: Is there an entry fee?
q2.answer: Many outdoor areas are free; the cistern has a ticket. Check on site.

q3.question: Can I visit with children?
q3.answer: Yes, most sites are suitable for families with basic supervision.

q4.question: Is it open every day?
q4.answer: Outdoor sites are generally accessible daily; indoor sites may close one day a week.

q5.question: Do I need a guide?
q5.answer: Not required, but a local guide enriches the history of the Portuguese City.
